q.en: How do I book an appointment?

a.en: Contact 6285242636424 to ask about appointments and registration.

a.id: Jl. Malik Raya No.2 (depan Bank Sultra Tower), Kendari, Sulawesi Tenggara Konfirmasikan titik lokasi sebelum berangkat.
a.en: Jl. Malik Raya No.2 (depan Bank Sultra Tower), Kendari, Sulawesi Tenggara Please confirm the location before travelling.

a.en: Confirm the schedule with staff before visiting. A doctor's schedule may differ from clinic opening hours.

q.en: How much does an examination cost?

q.en: Do you accept insurance or BPJS?
